the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def objects(g):
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(g) and 0<=nc<len(g[0]) and g[nr][nc]==col and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            stack.append((nr,nc))
                objs.append(cells)
    return objs

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=objects(g)
    # gravity direction: toward 2-row
    two_row = next(r for r in range(H) if all(x==2 for x in g[r]))
    d = -1 if two_row==0 else 1
    grid=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    grid[two_row]=[2]*W
    pos=[list(c) for c in objs]
    while True:
        # try move all one step d
        newpos=[[(r+d,c) for r,c in p] for p in pos]
        occ=set()
        ok=True
        for p in newpos:
            for r,c in p:
                if not(0<=r<H) or grid[r][c]==2 or (r,c) in occ:
                    ok=False; break
                occ.add((r,c))
            if not ok: break
        if not ok: break
        pos=newpos
    for p in pos:
        for r,c in p: grid[r][c]=g[objs[0][0][0]][objs[0][0][1]] if False else None
    # need colors: recompute per object
    for p,cells in zip(pos,objs):
        col=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        for r,c in p: grid[r][c]=col
    return grid
